title: Quiet Space
welcome: Hi, thanks for helping us test this website. I'll guide you through a few short tasks, one at a time. There are no wrong answers. We're testing the site, not you.

tasks.title: Book a room
tasks.say: You've got a group project meeting with three coursemates tomorrow afternoon. You need somewhere quiet from 2pm to 4pm. Use the app to find a room and book it

tasks.title: Check the booking
tasks.say: One of your group has messaged asking where you're meeting. Find the details of the booking you just made.

tasks.title: Book a room with step-free access
tasks.say: Another week, one of your group uses a wheelchair. Book a room for 6 people this Friday from 11am to 1pm that has step-free access

thanks: Your answers help us fix the confusing bits.
